result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout problem in the 'Popular right now' section where a card's content overflows horizontally, hiding an interactive element.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section overflows the right edge of the screen. Consequently, the favorite (heart) icon in the top right corner of the image is cut off and partially invisible, hindering interaction.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the width or margins of the cards in this list so they fit within the screen bounds, ensuring all interactive elements are fully visible and accessible.
